subject: DI02005021

body.en:
Definition

Agitation is induced motion in a fluid; mixing reduces spatial non-uniformity of composition, temperature or dispersed phases. Agitating alone does not guarantee complete mixing.

Classification

  • Axial-flow propellers/pitched blades drive flow mainly along the shaft; radial turbines discharge mainly outward; tangential paddles/anchors sweep around the vessel.
  • Geometry and flow classification are different axes. Pitched-blade flow depends on pitch/installation; anchors/helical systems suit some viscous duties.
  • Choose suspension, dispersion, heat-transfer or homogenisation duty before choosing impeller, diameter and speed.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Agitation fluidમાં motion પેદા કરે; mixingથી composition, temperature/dispersed phasesની અસમાનતા ઘટે. માત્ર motionથી સંપૂર્ણ mixing જરૂરી નથી.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Axial propeller/pitched blade shaftની દિશામાં, radial turbine બહાર તરફ, tangential paddle/anchor vesselની આસપાસ flow આપે.
  • Geometry/flow classification જુદા આધાર. Pitched bladeનું flow pitch/installation પર; anchor/helical કેટલીક viscous serviceમાં ઉપયોગી.
  • Impeller, diameter/speed પહેલાં suspension, dispersion, heat transfer કે homogenisation duty નક્કી કરો.

body.en:
Definition

Swirling is bulk rotational flow; a free-surface vortex is the depression associated with rotation and may entrain air when severe.

Explanation

  • An unbaffled central impeller may spin the liquid with weak turnover; visible motion is not proof of homogeneity.
  • Vortex may reduce useful mixing and entrain gas, causing foaming or unstable loads.

Factors and selection

  • Baffles interrupt tangential flow; off-centre/inclined arrangements and appropriate flow-guiding designs may help. Baffling can raise power demand.
  • Viscosity, density, phase fractions, particle size, impeller type/location, speed and vessel geometry affect mixing.
  • Use a defined mixing endpoint and sampling plan; not appearance alone.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Swirling bulk rotational flow; rotationથી free surfaceમાં depression vortex, વધારે હોય તો air entrainment થાય.

સમજણ

  • Unbaffled central impellerથી liquid ફરતું રહે પણ turnover ઓછું; motion એટલે homogeneity નહીં.
  • Vortexથી useful mixing ઘટે, gas/foam તથા unstable load થઈ શકે.

પરિબળો તથા પસંદગી

  • Baffles tangential flow તોડે; off-centre/inclined તથા યોગ્ય flow guides મદદ કરે. Bafflingથી power વધી શકે.
  • Viscosity, density, phase fractions, size, impeller type/location, speed/vessel geometry અસર કરે.
  • Mixing endpoint/sampling plan નક્કી કરો; માત્ર દેખાવ નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A mixing index compares measured composition variability with defined segregated and random reference states; its formula must be stated.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. Use binary equal-particle sampling with0<p<1, n>1 and k>1.Let p be overall tracer fraction, n independent particles per sample, and xi the k equal-basis sample fractions.
  2. For a segregated reference, samples are locally pure:xi is1 with probability p and0 with probability1−p.Variance is s0²=E[xi²]−p²=p−p²=p(1−p).
  3. For random mixing, the tracer count K in one sample is binomial:Var(K)=np(1−p).Since xi=K/n, random fraction variance sr²=Var(K)/n²=p(1−p)/n.
  4. Calculate measured mean xbar=Σxi/k and sample variance s²=Σ(xi−xbar)²/(k−1).Keep sample scale fixed when comparing results.
  5. Lacey normalises the reduction in variance:ML=(s0²−s²)/(s0²−sr²).At s²=s0², ML=0; at s²=sr², ML=1.
  6. All terms are variances of fractions, so ML is dimensionless.Values outside0–1 can occur from sampling/model mismatch; investigate rather than silently clipping.Other standard-deviation indices are not the same formula.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Measured composition variabilityને segregated/random reference સાથે સરખાવતું mixing index; formula સ્પષ્ટ આપવું.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Binary equal-particle samplingમાં0<p<1, n>1, k>1 લો.p overall tracer fraction, n independent particles/sample તથા xi એ k equal-basis sample fractions છે.
  2. Segregated referenceમાં xi=1ની probability p, xi=0ની1−p; variance s0²=E[xi²]−p²=p−p²=p(1−p).
  3. Random mixingમાં tracer count K binomial; Var(K)=np(1−p).xi=K/n હોવાથી sr²=Var(K)/n²=p(1−p)/n.
  4. Measured mean xbar=Σxi/k, sample variance s²=Σ(xi−xbar)²/(k−1).Comparisonમાં sample scale સમાન રાખો.
  5. Lacey variance reduction normalise કરે:ML=(s0²−s²)/(s0²−sr²).s²=s0²માં ML=0; s²=sr²માં ML=1.
  6. બધાં terms fraction variance હોવાથી ML નિરેક છે.Sampling/model mismatchથી0–1બહાર value આવે તો તપાસો, clip નહીં.Standard-deviation indices આ formula સમાન નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Power number is a dimensionless relation between agitator shaft power and inertial scale for a specified geometry.

Exam-ready ordered derivation

  1. Assume fixed impeller/vessel geometry, ungassed liquid and negligible additional free-surface effects.Let shaft power depend on density ρ, rotation rate N in rev/s, diameter D and viscosity μ.Dimensional groups give P/(ρN³D⁵)=Φ(ρND²/μ, geometry).
  2. Define Re=ρND²/μ and Np=P/(ρN³D⁵).Therefore P=NpρN³D⁵ with Np obtained for the correct geometry and regime.
  3. Unit check:ρN³D⁵=(kg/m³)(s⁻³)(m⁵)=kg·m²/s³=W.Power number is dimensionless.
  4. In laminar service with geometry constant, NpRe≈K.Then Np=K/Re and substitution gives P≈KμN²D³.
  5. In a suitable fully turbulent baffled regime, Np approaches a geometry-dependent constant, so P∝ρN³D⁵.Do not transfer the constant to a different impeller.
  6. For measured torque T, work per revolution=2πT and P=2πNT.Hence T=P/(2πN), with N=rpm/60.
  7. Electrical input differs from shaft power.If a valid overall efficiency η is stated, Pshaft=ηPinput; otherwise do not label raw input or an idle-subtracted electrical value as shaft power.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

નિર્ધારિત geometryમાં shaft power/inertial scaleનો નિરેક સંબંધ power number છે.

પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ક્રમબદ્ધ તારવણી

  1. Fixed geometry, ungassed liquid તથા negligible additional free-surface effects માનો.Shaft power ρ, N rev/s, D, μ પર આધારિત છે.Dimensional groupsથી P/(ρN³D⁵)=Φ(ρND²/μ, geometry).
  2. Re=ρND²/μ, Np=P/(ρN³D⁵) વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરતાં P=NpρN³D⁵; Np યોગ્ય geometry/regimeમાંથી લો.
  3. Unit check:ρN³D⁵=(kg/m³)(s⁻³)(m⁵)=kg·m²/s³=W.Power number નિરેક છે.
  4. Fixed geometryના laminar serviceમાં NpRe≈K; Np=K/Re મૂકતાં P≈KμN²D³.
  5. Suitable fully turbulent baffled regimeમાં Np geometry-dependent constant બને એટલે P∝ρN³D⁵.બીજા impellerમાં constant સીધો ન લો.
  6. Measured torque Tમાં work/revolution=2πT; P=2πNT, T=P/(2πN), N=rpm/60.
  7. Electrical input/shaft power જુદાં.Valid efficiency ηમાં Pshaft=ηPinput; નહીં તો raw input/idle-subtracted electrical valueને shaft power ન કહો.

body.en:
Definition

A vessel fitted with a driven impeller to provide a specified liquid-mixing duty.

Principle

  • Impeller transfers momentum to the fluid; circulation and local shear act together.

Construction—detailed theory

An agitated vessel provides a defined working liquid volume inside a supported tank (1). A motor and, where required, gearbox and shaft support (2) drive a shaft passing through a suitable seal (3). An impeller selected for the duty is attached to the shaft (4). Impeller diameter, clearance and location influence the circulation pattern.

Baffles fixed near the vessel wall (5) oppose excessive tangential flow when appropriate. Designed inlets and outlets (6), and jackets or coils if required, serve material and heat-transfer needs. Baffles do not rotate with the shaft. The sketch is a general baffled-vessel arrangement; the best impeller and baffling depend on viscosity, phases and the required mixing objective.

Working—detailed theory

The impeller transfers shaft work to the liquid, accelerating fluid near its blades. This local motion creates larger circulation loops that transport liquid throughout the vessel. Axial impellers promote flow along the shaft direction, whereas radial turbines discharge mainly outward; the returning flow completes the circulation. Local shear and bulk circulation contribute differently to dispersion and blending.

In a baffled tank, baffles interrupt bulk rotation and help convert motion into useful turnover rather than a deep vortex. Material is redistributed until the specified composition, suspension or heat-transfer objective is reached. Merely seeing the liquid rotate does not establish mixing quality; a defined endpoint or sampling test is needed. Power must be related to the actual geometry, speed and flow regime.

Applications

  • Blending liquids, solid suspension, gas dispersion and heat-transfer assistance with suitable impellers.

Limitations and safety

  • No exposed shaft contact or live sampling near blades; chemical/pressure service needs qualified design.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

નિર્ધારિત liquid-mixing duty માટે driven impellerવાળું vessel.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Impeller fluidને momentum આપે; circulation તથા local shear કામ કરે.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Agitated vesselમાં supported tank (1)માં defined working liquid volume રહે છે. Motor, જરૂર મુજબ gearbox/shaft support (2), suitable seal (3)માંથી પસાર થતા shaftને ચલાવે છે. Duty મુજબ selected impeller (4) જોડાયેલ હોય છે. Diameter, clearance/location circulation patternને અસર કરે છે.

યોગ્ય serviceમાં wall પાસે fixed baffles (5) excessive tangential flow રોકે છે. Inlet/outlet (6) તથા જરૂરી jacket/coils material/heat-transfer માટે છે. Baffles shaft સાથે ફરતા નથી. આ general baffled arrangement છે; યોગ્ય impeller/baffling viscosity, phases/mixing objective પ્રમાણે પસંદ થાય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Impeller shaft work liquidને આપી blades પાસે fluid accelerate કરે છે. તેનાથી મોટા circulation loops બની liquid આખા vesselમાં જાય છે. Axial impeller shaft directionમાં અને radial turbine બહાર તરફ flow આપે; return flow loop પૂર્ણ કરે છે. Local shear તથા bulk circulation dispersion/blendingમાં જુદી ભૂમિકા ભજવે છે.

Baffles bulk rotation તોડી deep vortex કરતાં useful turnover વધારે છે. Specified composition, suspension કે heat-transfer objective સુધી material redistribute થાય છે. માત્ર liquid ફરતું દેખાય એટલે mixing quality સાબિત નથી; defined endpoint/sampling જરૂરી છે. Power માટે actual geometry, speed/flow regime ધ્યાનમાં લેવા પડે.

ઉપયોગો

  • યોગ્ય impellerથી liquid blending, solid suspension, gas dispersion/heat transfer.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Exposed shaft/blades પાસે contact/live sampling નહીં; chemical/pressure serviceમાં qualified design.

body.en:
Definition

A horizontal trough mixer with helical ribbons on a shaft.

Principle

  • Inner/outer ribbons move material axially in opposing directions while turning it across the trough.

Construction—detailed theory

A ribbon blender has a long U-shaped trough (1) enclosing a horizontal driven shaft (2). Helical ribbons of different diameters are supported from the shaft: an outer ribbon near the wall (3) and an inner ribbon nearer the shaft (4). Their pitches are arranged to produce opposing axial movements rather than simply push the whole batch to one end.

The loading cover and guards (5) enclose the rotating assembly, while a bottom valve or outlet (6) permits discharge. Designed ribbon-to-wall clearances avoid direct rubbing and excessive build-up. The selected working fill must leave room for solids circulation. This machine uses ribbons for bulk powder movement, not balls for grinding.

Working—detailed theory

Rotation of the shaft moves the outer and inner ribbons through the powder bed. One ribbon conveys material predominantly in one axial direction while the other promotes return movement. At the same time particles move between inner and outer regions, giving radial exchange as well as axial transport. These overlapping paths distribute material through the trough.

Repeated convective transport and local particle rearrangement reduce composition differences. Mixing time depends on fill, ribbon geometry, speed and material flowability; poorly flowing cohesive feed may form dead zones. When the specified uniformity is reached, the machine is stopped and material discharged by the approved arrangement. Overmixing does not necessarily improve uniformity if size or density differences promote segregation.

Applications

  • Blending compatible powders/granules or selected light pastes.

Limitations and safety

  • Segregation, dust and dead zones can occur. No hands/tools through an operating cover.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Shaft પર helical ribbonsવાળું horizontal trough mixer.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Inner/outer ribbons materialને વિરુદ્ધ axial દિશામાં તથા troughમાં આડું ખસેડે.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Ribbon blenderમાં લાંબો U-shaped trough (1) અને horizontal driven shaft (2) હોય છે. Shaftથી supported જુદા diameterનાં helical ribbons હોય:wall પાસે outer ribbon (3), shaft પાસે inner ribbon (4). Pitchesથી opposing axial movement મળે; આખો batch એક end પર જ દબાય એવું નથી.

Loading cover/guards (5) rotating assembly ઢાંકે અને bottom valve/outlet (6) discharge આપે. Designed wall clearancesથી direct rubbing/excess build-up ટળે. Working fillમાં circulation માટે જગ્યા જરૂરી છે. Ribbons powderને bulkમાં ખસેડે છે; grinding ballsવાળી machine નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Shaft ફરતાં inner/outer ribbons powder bedમાં ફરે છે. એક ribbon materialને એક axial directionમાં અને બીજું return directionમાં ખસેડે છે. સાથે particles inner/outer regions વચ્ચે જાય એટલે radial exchange પણ મળે. આ જોડાયેલા pathsથી troughમાં material ફેલાય છે.

Repeated convective transport તથા local rearrangementથી composition differences ઘટે છે. Fill, geometry, speed/flowabilityથી mixing time બદલાય; cohesive feedમાં dead zones થઈ શકે. Required uniformity પછી approved arrangementથી stop/discharge થાય. Size/density differences segregation કરાવે તો વધુ mixing હંમેશાં લાભદાયક નથી.

ઉપયોગો

  • Compatible powders/granules તથા પસંદ કરેલી light pastes.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Segregation, dust/dead zones થાય. ચાલતા coverમાંથી હાથ/tools નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A batch mixer with two counter-rotating kneading blades for viscous plastic masses.

Principle

  • Compression, shear, stretching and folding repeatedly redistribute a high-viscosity material.

Construction—detailed theory

The kneader contains a double-trough chamber (1) with two sigma- or Z-shaped blades (2). Separate supported shafts and gearing (3) provide the required counter-rotating motion, often with a selected speed difference according to design. Small designed blade-wall and blade-blade clearances (4) create the working zones without requiring the metal surfaces to rub together.

A closed loading cover and a jacket where specified (5) provide containment and thermal control. The thick product is removed by a designed tilting or bottom-discharge system (6). The drive must supply high torque for viscous materials, and the construction is more robust than a light-duty liquid-blending vessel. Guards and interlocks protect access to the blades.

Working—detailed theory

Viscous feed is taken up by the rotating blades and repeatedly divided, folded and transferred from one trough region to the other. Material is stretched and compressed as it passes through the controlled clearances. This combination produces strong local shear and bulk kneading even when the material is too viscous to form ordinary liquid-circulation loops.

Continued folding brings fresh portions into the high-stress zones and distributes ingredients throughout the mass. Frictional work can generate considerable heat, so a specified jacket controls temperature where needed. After the required consistency and uniformity are obtained, the unit is stopped and discharged by its approved mechanism. The process is not simply stirring a low-viscosity fluid with a propeller.

Applications

  • Dough, paste, adhesive and similar viscous formulations.

Limitations and safety

  • High torque/heat and pinch hazards; not a free-flowing liquid impeller. No manual access until zero energy.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Viscous plastic mass માટે બે counter-rotating kneading bladesવાળું batch mixer.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Compression, shear, stretching/foldingથી viscous material ફરી વહેંચાય.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Kneaderમાં double-trough chamber (1) તથા બે sigma/Z-shaped blades (2) હોય છે. Supported shafts/gearing (3) required counter-rotation આપે; design મુજબ speeds જુદી હોઈ શકે. Designed blade-wall/blade-blade clearances (4) working zones બનાવે; metal surfacesને ઘસાવવાની જરૂર નથી.

Closed loading cover તથા specified jacket (5) containment/temperature control આપે. Thick product માટે designed tilting/bottom discharge (6) હોય છે. Viscous material માટે high-torque drive અને robust construction જોઈએ; light liquid blender જેવું નહીં. Guards/interlocks blades સુધી access રોકે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Rotating blades viscous feedને લઈ વારંવાર divide, fold તથા એક troughથી બીજામાં transfer કરે છે. Controlled clearancesમાંથી પસાર થતાં material stretch/compress થાય છે. તેથી સામાન્ય liquid circulation ન બનાવી શકે એટલા viscous materialમાં પણ local shear તથા bulk kneading મળે છે.

Repeated foldingથી નવા ભાગો high-stress zonesમાં આવે અને ingredients આખા massમાં ફેલાય. Frictional workથી heat બને એટલે જરૂર મુજબ jacket temperature control કરે. Required consistency/uniformity પછી stop કરીને approved mechanismથી discharge થાય. આ low-viscosity liquidને propellerથી stir કરવા જેવી ક્રિયા નથી.

ઉપયોગો

  • Dough, paste, adhesive જેવી viscous formulations.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • High torque/heat/pinch જોખમ; સામાન્ય liquid impeller નહીં. Zero energy પછી જ access.

body.en:
Definition

An enclosed batch internal mixer using opposed rotors and a loading ram.

Principle

  • High shear and compression between rotors and chamber disperse ingredients into viscous material.

Construction—detailed theory

A Banbury mixer has a strong enclosed chamber (1) containing two specially shaped counter-rotating rotors (2). A feed opening and loading ram (3) press the charge into the rotor region. A high-torque drive (4) supplies the work needed for thick materials; rotor shape and clearances create repeated deformation rather than relying on a free liquid vortex.

Designed cooling surfaces or passages (5) remove part of the heat produced by mechanical work. A robust discharge door (6) releases the completed batch and is interlocked with safe access arrangements. The illustration simplifies seals, cooling connections and controls; actual operation depends on a specified ram, rotor and temperature programme.

Working—detailed theory

The charge enters the chamber and the ram keeps it engaged with the rotors. As the rotors turn, their shaped surfaces draw, split and circulate the mass. Material is repeatedly squeezed and sheared in the designed clearances between rotors and chamber surfaces, promoting both ingredient distribution and breakdown of suitable agglomerates.

High mechanical work raises the material temperature, making cooling and the prescribed cycle important. Mixing continues until the specified endpoint, which may involve time, temperature, energy or product condition. The batch is then released through the designed door under the approved operating sequence. A Banbury is an internal high-shear mixer, not a classifier or a low-power powder tumbler.

Applications

  • Industrial rubber/polymer compounding and difficult dispersions.

Limitations and safety

  • High stored mechanical/thermal energy and ram hazards. Theory only unless an authorised guarded trainer is supplied.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Opposed rotors/loading ramવાળું enclosed batch internal mixer.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Rotors/chamber વચ્ચે high shear/compressionથી ingredients viscous materialમાં disperse થાય.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Banbury mixerમાં strong enclosed chamber (1), બે shaped counter-rotating rotors (2) તથા feed opening/loading ram (3) હોય છે. Ram chargeને rotor regionમાં રાખે છે. High-torque drive (4) thick material માટે work આપે; rotor shape/clearances repeated deformation કરે, free liquid vortex પર આધાર નહીં.

Cooling surfaces/passages (5) mechanical workથી બનતી heatનો ભાગ દૂર કરે. Robust discharge door (6) completed batch બહાર કાઢે અને safe-access interlocks ધરાવે. Drawingમાં seals, cooling connections/controls સરળ કરેલ છે; actual operation specified ram, rotor/temperature programme પ્રમાણે થાય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Charge chamberમાં આવે અને ram તેને rotors સાથે working contactમાં રાખે. Shaped rotors massને draw, split તથા circulate કરે. Rotor/chamber surfaces વચ્ચેની clearancesમાં material વારંવાર squeeze/shear થાય; તેથી ingredients distribute થાય તથા suitable agglomerates તૂટે છે.

High mechanical workથી temperature વધે એટલે cooling/prescribed cycle મહત્વનાં છે. Time, temperature, energy/product conditionના specified endpoint સુધી mixing થાય. પછી approved sequenceથી discharge door દ્વારા batch બહાર આવે. Banbury internal high-shear mixer છે; classifier કે low-power powder tumbler નહીં.

ઉપયોગો

  • Industrial rubber/polymer compounding તથા મુશ્કેલ dispersions.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • ઉચ્ચ mechanical/thermal energy તથા ram hazards. Authorised trainer વિના માત્ર theory.

body.en:
Definition

A pan mixer in which heavy wheels mull material while ploughs redistribute it.

Principle

  • Rolling compression and rubbing distribute/bind granular material.

Construction—detailed theory

A muller has a circular pan (1) and heavy mulling wheels (2). A driven carrier, or design-specific relative pan motion, moves the wheels over the material (3). Ploughs and scrapers (4) redirect material into the wheel paths and reduce accumulation near the pan wall. The wheels apply pressure as they roll through the bed.

A guarded central drive (5) supplies the motion, while designed loading and discharge openings (6) serve the batch. Wheel loading and clearances are selected to suit the material and required coating or kneading action. The pan and wheels form a combined mixing-working system; the machine should not be drawn as a plain impeller suspended in a liquid tank.

Working—detailed theory

Material loaded in the pan is pressed, rubbed and worked by the moving wheels. The pressure helps break weak lumps and spread a liquid binder or coating over particles when that is the selected duty. Relative motion between wheel, bed and pan supplies shear as well as compression; the objective is controlled mulling rather than necessarily fine grinding.

Ploughs turn and return material to the working path, repeatedly exposing fresh portions to the wheels. This circulation combines mechanical working with composition redistribution and coating. Once the required condition is achieved, material leaves through the approved discharge arrangement. Fill, moisture, wheel load and time affect the result; excessive working can damage particles or generate unwanted heat.

Applications

  • Foundry-sand preparation and compatible granular/paste mixing.

Limitations and safety

  • Wheel nip points and dust require enclosure. Do not clear pan during motion.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Heavy wheelsથી mulling તથા ploughsથી redistribution થતું pan mixer.

સિદ્ધાંત

  • Rolling compression/rubbingથી granular materialનું distribution/binding થાય.

રચના—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Mullerમાં circular pan (1), heavy mulling wheels (2) તથા driven carrier/design-specific relative pan motion (3) હોય છે. Ploughs/scrapers (4) materialને ફરી wheel pathમાં લાવે તથા wall પાસે accumulation ઘટાડે. Wheels bed પર roll થતાં pressure આપે છે.

Guarded central drive (5) motion આપે અને designed loading/discharge openings (6) batch handle કરે. Material તથા coating/kneading duty મુજબ wheel loading/clearances પસંદ થાય. Pan-wheels સાથે mixing/working કરે; આકૃતિને liquid tankના plain impeller જેવી ન દોરવી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ—વિગતવાર સમજણ

Panનું material moving wheelsથી press, rub/work થાય છે. Suitable dutyમાં weak lumps તૂટે તથા liquid binder/coating particles પર ફેલાય છે. Wheel-bed-pan relative motionથી compression સાથે shear મળે. હેતુ controlled mulling છે; જરૂરી રીતે fine grinding નહીં.

Ploughs material ફેરવી working pathમાં પાછું લાવે જેથી નવા ભાગો wheels નીચે આવે. તેથી mechanical working, redistribution/coating જોડાય છે. Required condition પછી approved dischargeથી material જાય. Fill, moisture, wheel load/time પરિણામને અસર કરે; excess workingથી particle damage/heat થઈ શકે.

ઉપયોગો

  • Foundry-sand તથા compatible granular/paste mixing.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

  • Wheel nip/dust માટે enclosure. Motionમાં pan clearing નહીં.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

Binary equal-particle mixture:p=0.40, n=100particles per sample; measured sample variance s²=0.012.

To find

Calculate Lacey index and interpret the sampling reference.

Governing relation and assumptions

Equal independent particles per sample:s0²=p(1−p), sr²=p(1−p)/n, ML=(s0²−s²)/(s0²−sr²).

Calculation with substitution

  1. s0²=p(1−p)=0.24; sr²=p(1−p)/n=0.0024.
  2. ML=(0.24−0.012)/(0.24−0.0024)=0.959596≈0.960.
  3. Interpretation:close to the defined random reference at this sample scale; not proof of perfect microscopic uniformity.

Final answer

s0²=0.24; sr²=0.0024; ML≈0.9596≈0.960.

Unit/physical check

sr²<s²<s0², so0<ML<1.This is near the random reference at the given sample scale, not perfect microscopic uniformity.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો—પ્રયોગની readings નહીં

આપેલી માહિતી

Binary equal-particle mixture:p=0.40, n=100particles/sample; s²=0.012.

શું શોધવું

Lacey index ગણો તથા sampling reference સમજાવો.

સૂત્ર તથા ધારણાઓ

Sampleમાં equal independent particles:s0²=p(1−p), sr²=p(1−p)/n, ML=(s0²−s²)/(s0²−sr²).

મૂલ્યો મૂકીને ગણતરી

  1. s0²=0.24; sr²=0.0024.
  2. ML=(0.24−0.012)/(0.24−0.0024)=0.959596≈0.960.
  3. આ sample scaleના random referenceની નજીક; perfect microscopic uniformityનો પુરાવો નહીં.

અંતિમ જવાબ

s0²=0.24; sr²=0.0024; ML≈0.9596≈0.960.

એકમ તથા યોગ્યતાની ચકાસણી

sr²<s²<s0² એટલે0<ML<1.તે આ scaleના random referenceની નજીક છે; perfect microscopic uniformity નહીં.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical—not laboratory readings

Given data

Given Np=5, ρ=1000kg/m³, μ=0.001Pa·s, N=120rpm=2s⁻¹, D=0.20m.

To find

Find Re, shaft power, torque and electrical input at the stated efficiency.

Governing relation and assumptions

N=rpm/60; Re=ρND²/μ; Pshaft=NpρN³D⁵; T=Pshaft/(2πN); Pinput=Pshaft/η.Use the given Np only for its geometry/regime.

Calculation with substitution

  1. Re=ρND²/μ=80000.Use Np=5 only for its stated geometry/regime.
  2. P=NpρN³D⁵=5×1000×2³×0.2⁵=12.8W.
  3. Torque T=P/(2πN)=12.8/(4π)=1.019N·m.
  4. If shaft efficiency from electrical input is0.80 at this load, corresponding input=12.8/0.80=16W, not12.8W.

Final answer

Re=80000; Pshaft=12.8W; T≈1.019N·m; Pinput=16W forη=0.80.

Unit/physical check

120rpm=2s⁻¹, not120s⁻¹.Input must exceed shaft output forη<1; P has watt units.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો—પ્રયોગની readings નહીં

આપેલી માહિતી

Np=5, ρ=1000kg/m³, μ=0.001Pa·s, N=120rpm=2s⁻¹, D=0.20m.

શું શોધવું

Re, shaft power, torque તથા stated efficiencyમાં electrical input શોધો.

સૂત્ર તથા ધારણાઓ

N=rpm/60; Re=ρND²/μ; Pshaft=NpρN³D⁵; T=Pshaft/(2πN); Pinput=Pshaft/η.Np તેની geometry/regime માટે જ.

મૂલ્યો મૂકીને ગણતરી

  1. Re=80000.Np=5 તેના આપેલા geometry/regime માટે જ.
  2. P=NpρN³D⁵=12.8W.
  3. Torque T=P/(2πN)=1.019N·m.
  4. આ load પર electrical-to-shaft efficiency0.80 હોય તો input16W, 12.8W નહીં.

અંતિમ જવાબ

Re=80000; Pshaft=12.8W; T≈1.019N·m; η=0.80માં Pinput=16W.

એકમ તથા યોગ્યતાની ચકાસણી

120rpm=2s⁻¹, 120s⁻¹ નહીં.η<1માં input shaft outputથી વધારે હોવું જોઈએ; P wattsમાં.

body.en:
Aim and scope

  • Estimate Lacey index at a stated sample scale using actual independent composition samples.

Instruments/materials

  • Covered guarded mixer, approved binary equal-particle mixture, trays, sampler, balance/counting method and timer.

Connections/setup

  • Record total composition p and particles per sample n; sampling method must avoid preferential selection and be identical at each time.

Procedure

  1. Load approved batch and run at prescribed mixing time/speed under guarding.
  2. Stop and isolate before taking k equal-basis spatial samples; record location and tracer fraction xi.
  3. Repeat approved times with a valid independent sampling plan; do not return samples if it changes the stated mass basis.
  4. Compute sample mean, variance and references; compare time dependence with sampling uncertainty.

Blank observation sheet

  • Mixing time ___s, k ___, n ___, p ___; location ___, tracer count ___, total count ___, xi ___; xbar ___, Σ(xi−xbar)² ___.

Calculations and blank result

  • s²=Σ(xi−xbar)²/(k−1); s0²=p(1−p); sr²=p(1−p)/n; ML=(s0²−s²)/(s0²−sr²). Result ML ___ at ___s, n ___.
  • Do not silently clip outside0–1; check sample scale, particle equivalence and model assumptions.

Safe fault-finding

  • After isolation inspect dead zones, overfill and blade condition; review biased sampling before changing speed.

Precautions

  • Use only the instructor-approved guarded trainer and compatible nonhazardous sample; record apparatus ID and authorised settings.
  • Isolate electrical/mechanical/pressure energy before opening, adjusting or clearing equipment; an emergency stop is not isolation.
  • Wear specified PPE, control dust/spills and follow the laboratory waste procedure; do not improvise live fault tests.
  • No hand sampling near moving blades; do not use edible samples for eating after laboratory use.
body.gu:
હેતુ તથા મર્યાદા

  • Actual independent composition samplesથી stated sample scale પર Lacey index.

સાધનો/પદાર્થો

  • Covered guarded mixer, approved binary equal-particle mixture, trays, sampler, balance/counting method/timer.

જોડાણ/ગોઠવણ

  • Total composition p/particles per sample n લખો; preferential selection વગર સમાન sampling method.

કાર્યક્રમ

  1. Approved batch, prescribed time/speed guarding સાથે.
  2. Stop/isolate પછી k equal-basis spatial samples; location/xi લખો.
  3. Valid independent planથી approved times repeat; mass basis બદલાય તો samples પાછા ન નાખો.
  4. Mean, variance/references ગણો; sampling uncertainty સાથે time effect સરખાવો.

ખાલી અવલોકન પત્રક

  • Mixing time ___s, k ___, n ___, p ___; location ___, tracer count ___, total count ___, xi ___; xbar ___, Σ(xi−xbar)² ___.

ગણતરી તથા ખાલી પરિણામ

  • s²=Σ(xi−xbar)²/(k−1); s0²=p(1−p); sr²=p(1−p)/n; ML=(s0²−s²)/(s0²−sr²). Result ML ___, time ___s, n ___.
  • 0–1બહાર value ચુપચાપ clip નહીં; sample scale/equal-particle assumptions તપાસો.

સલામત Fault-Finding

  • Isolation પછી dead zones, overfill/blades; speed બદલતાં પહેલાં biased sampling જુઓ.

સાવચેતીઓ

  • Instructor-approved guarded trainer તથા compatible nonhazardous sample જ; apparatus ID/authorised settings લખો.
  • ખોલતાં, adjust/clear કરતાં પહેલાં electrical/mechanical/pressure energy isolate કરો; emergency stop isolation નથી.
  • નિર્ધારિત PPE, dust/spill control તથા laboratory waste procedure અનુસરો; live fault test improvisation નહીં.
  • Moving blades પાસે hand sampling નહીં; lab sample ખાવું નહીં.

body.en:
Aim and scope

  • Determine shaft power/power number at approved conditions and distinguish electrical input from shaft work.

Instruments/materials

  • Guarded baffled-vessel trainer, known impeller diameter, fluid density/viscosity, speed indicator, calibrated torque sensor or authorised true-power meter.

Connections/setup

  • Instructor verifies shaft guard, baffle fixings, liquid level and sensor/meter connection while isolated; electrical wiring by authorised staff only.

Procedure

  1. Measure/record fluid properties, impeller type/D, geometry and working level.
  2. Run at approved speeds; record steady rpm and torque or documented electrical/load-loss basis.
  3. Observe vortex/air entrainment externally; stop before changing baffles or taking internal measurements.
  4. Calculate P, Re, Np consistently and compare only with matching-geometry reference data.

Blank observation sheet

  • D ___m, ρ ___kg/m³, μ ___Pa·s, rpm ___, N ___s⁻¹, T ___N·m, Pinput ___W, loss/efficiency basis ___, Pshaft ___W, Re ___, Np ___.

Calculations and blank result

  • N=rpm/60; Pshaft=2πNT; Re=ρND²/μ; Np=Pshaft/(ρN³D⁵). If using electrical readings, apply only a validated shaft-power conversion.
  • Result:P ___W, Np ___, Re ___, geometry/regime ___; do not label VI or net electrical difference as shaft power without justification.

Safe fault-finding

  • After isolation check sensor zero, wrong rpm conversion, loose baffles, viscosity/temperature and aeration; no live shaft adjustment.

Precautions

  • Use only the instructor-approved guarded trainer and compatible nonhazardous sample; record apparatus ID and authorised settings.
  • Isolate electrical/mechanical/pressure energy before opening, adjusting or clearing equipment; an emergency stop is not isolation.
  • Wear specified PPE, control dust/spills and follow the laboratory waste procedure; do not improvise live fault tests.
  • Never remove a baffle/guard while rotating; do not use an exposed mains connection for student measurement.
body.gu:
હેતુ તથા મર્યાદા

  • Approved conditionsમાં shaft power/power number; electrical inputથી જુદું પાડો.

સાધનો/પદાર્થો

  • Guarded baffled vessel, known D, ρ/μ, speed indicator, calibrated torque sensor/authorised true-power meter.

જોડાણ/ગોઠવણ

  • Isolationમાં instructor shaft guard, baffles, level/sensor connection; wiring authorised staff જ.

કાર્યક્રમ

  1. Fluid properties, impeller type/D, geometry/working level.
  2. Approved speedsએ steady rpm/torque અથવા documented electrical/load-loss basis.
  3. બહારથી vortex/air observe; baffles/internal measurement પહેલાં stop.
  4. Consistent P, Re, Np; matching-geometry reference સાથે જ compare.

ખાલી અવલોકન પત્રક

  • D ___m, ρ ___kg/m³, μ ___Pa·s, rpm ___, N ___s⁻¹, T ___N·m, Pinput ___W, loss/efficiency basis ___, Pshaft ___W, Re ___, Np ___.

ગણતરી તથા ખાલી પરિણામ

  • N=rpm/60; Pshaft=2πNT; Re=ρND²/μ; Np=Pshaft/(ρN³D⁵). Electrical readingsમાં validated shaft-power conversion જ.
  • Result:P ___W, Np ___, Re ___, geometry/regime ___; VI/net electrical differenceને કારણ વિના shaft power નહીં.

સલામત Fault-Finding

  • Isolation પછી sensor zero, rpm conversion, baffles, μ/T/aeration; live shaft adjustment નહીં.

સાવચેતીઓ

  • Instructor-approved guarded trainer તથા compatible nonhazardous sample જ; apparatus ID/authorised settings લખો.
  • ખોલતાં, adjust/clear કરતાં પહેલાં electrical/mechanical/pressure energy isolate કરો; emergency stop isolation નથી.
  • નિર્ધારિત PPE, dust/spill control તથા laboratory waste procedure અનુસરો; live fault test improvisation નહીં.
  • Rotating વખતે baffle/guard remove નહીં; exposed mains student measurement નહીં.

a.en: Agitation is induced motion in a fluid; mixing reduces spatial non-uniformity of composition, temperature or dispersed phases. Agitating alone does not guarantee complete mixing.
a.gu: Agitation fluidમાં motion પેદા કરે; mixingથી composition, temperature/dispersed phasesની અસમાનતા ઘટે. માત્ર motionથી સંપૂર્ણ mixing જરૂરી નથી.

a.en: Swirling is bulk rotational flow; a free-surface vortex is the depression associated with rotation and may entrain air when severe.
a.gu: Swirling bulk rotational flow; rotationથી free surfaceમાં depression vortex, વધારે હોય તો air entrainment થાય.

a.en: A mixing index compares measured composition variability with defined segregated and random reference states; its formula must be stated.
a.gu: Measured composition variabilityને segregated/random reference સાથે સરખાવતું mixing index; formula સ્પષ્ટ આપવું.
